:root {
  --ghc-purple: #542779;
  --ghc-purple-dark: #35164f;
  --ghc-gold: #c79a3b;
  --ghc-paper: #fbf8f2;
  --ghc-ink: #241d29;
}

body { color: var(--ghc-ink); }
.mw-page-container { background: #fff; }
.page-首页 .mw-first-heading { display: none; }
.ghc-hero {
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  padding: clamp(2rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  border-radius: 18px;
  color: white;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.17) 0 4%, transparent 4.5%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ghc-purple-dark), var(--ghc-purple) 64%, #7d4aa0);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(53, 22, 79, .18);
}
.ghc-kicker { color: #ead9a9; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; }
.ghc-title { margin: .35rem 0; font-family: "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Songti SC", serif; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 8vw, 5.4rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ghc-subtitle { max-width: 35rem; color: #f1eaf5; font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.4vw, 1.35rem); }
.ghc-actions { margin-top: 1.6rem; }
.ghc-actions a { display: inline-block; margin: .25rem .6rem .25rem 0; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
.ghc-actions a:first-child { border-color: #fff; background: #fff; color: var(--ghc-purple-dark); }
.ghc-actions a:hover { text-decoration: none; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.ghc-notice { margin: 1.25rem 0 2rem; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border-left: 4px solid var(--ghc-gold); background: var(--ghc-paper); }
.ghc-years { display: grid; gap: .7rem; margin: 1rem 0 2rem; }
.ghc-year { padding: .85rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e0eb; }
.ghc-year span { display: inline-block; width: 4.5rem; color: var(--ghc-purple); font: 700 1.15rem/1.2 monospace; }
.ghc-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0 2rem; }
.ghc-card { padding: 1.1rem; border: 1px solid #e5dde9; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 7px 24px rgba(53,22,79,.06); }
.ghc-card-label { color: #806b88; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.ghc-card-title { margin: .25rem 0; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; }
.ghc-card p { margin: .35rem 0 0; color: #5d5362; }
.ghc-footer-note { margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #e5dde9; color: #746b78; font-size: .88rem; }
.ghc-source { margin: .75rem 0 1.2rem; }
.ghc-source-badge { display: inline-block; margin-right: .55rem; padding: .16rem .55rem; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; background: var(--ghc-purple); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; }
.ghc-source-note { color: #6f6473; font-size: .88rem; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .ghc-title { letter-spacing: .03em; }
  .ghc-year span { display: block; width: auto; margin-bottom: .25rem; }
}
